title: Understanding PCA Components
text: In PCA, the matrix U represents the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix, and Σ is a diagonal matrix with eigenvalues. Think about how these matrices interact when multiplied.

title: Matrix Multiplication
text: Consider the properties of matrix multiplication. What happens when you multiply a matrix of eigenvectors by a diagonal matrix of eigenvalues?

title: Interpreting UΣ
text: The product UΣ transforms the data into a new space defined by the principal components. This transformation is crucial for dimensionality reduction.
